messages:
sara (Partnerships): Ok team — final prep for marketplace announce (AWS Marketplace + HW SI bundle). Need alignment on press embargo, landing page, and SI playbook. Can we lock owners + deadlines?

dan (PM): I can own the landing copy / CTA flows. Deadline EOD Wed for draft.

leo (Marketing): Press embargo windows? partner wants Tue 9am PT. Need final PR by Monday COB.

nina (Product): Confirming feature matrix for HW bundle — sending final spec to oliver tomorrow AM.

oliver (Solutions): I'll draft SI integration docs and runbook. Need access to partner test tenants. @deploy-bot can you confirm tenant provisioning ETA?

deploy-bot: tenant-provision request received. ETA: 48 hours. Ticket #TP-4521

sara (Partnerships): Thanks. @leo can you coordinate PR with partner comms and give me an embargo SLA? Also need creative for landing hero by Thurs.

leo (Marketing): Yep — syncing with partner comms at 10am PT. Creative brief: hero + 3 bullets + CTA. Ask: can we reuse existing product screenshots or need hardware photography?

nina (Product): Product screenshots ok for now; partner wants a hero shot of the rack. Creative to confirm if they can provide high-res by Thu.

oliver (Solutions): For SI playbook, we need sequence: onboarding -> test plan -> go-live checklist. Putting initial checklist here:

```
- Preflight: tenant access, API keys, network allowlist
- Integration: connector install, model variant mapping
- Validation: perf tests (latency < 200ms p95), accuracy smoke tests
- Cutover: DNS, monitoring hooks, rollback plan
```

sara (Partnerships): Nice. Can we add owner tags? I'll add owners in a doc after this thread.

dan (PM): Blocker: legal needs to sign off on partner logos on landing. @legal-team FYI.

leo (Marketing): I'll loop legal. Also need blog draft: target publish Tue + partner quote. Need partner approval on quote.

sara (Partnerships): Partner comms confirmed the quote draft and will provide the hero rack photo by Thu EOD.

sara (Partnerships): Great. Action items: landing copy (dan) Wed EOD, hero creative (partner+leo) Thu EOD, PR final (leo) Mon COB, SI playbook draft (oliver) Fri AM, tenant provision (deploy-bot) 48h. Next sync: Wed 11am PT. /subscribe :calendar:
